MERGE INTO RD_CONTRACT_PAY_RECORD P USING (
SELECT sys_guid() AS PK_ID, #{item.rdProjectContractId} as RD_PROJECT_CONTRACT_ID, #{item.serial} as SERIAL, #{item.payNum} as PAY_NUM, #{item.payAmount} as PAY_AMOUNT, #{item.payment} as PAYMENT, #{item.comptime} as COMPTIME, #{item.createBy} as CREATE_BY, #{item.createDate} as CREATE_DATE FROM dual
) src ON (P.SERIAL = src.SERIAL)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET P.RD_PROJECT_CONTRACT_ID = src.RD_PROJECT_CONTRACT_ID, P.PAY_NUM = src.PAY_NUM, P.PAY_AMOUNT = src.PAY_AMOUNT, P.PAYMENT = src.PAYMENT, P.COMPTIME = src.COMPTIME, P.CREATE_BY = src.CREATE_BY, P.CREATE_DATE = src.CREATE_DATE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PK_ID,RD_PROJECT_CONTRACT_ID,SERIAL,PAY_NUM,PAY_AMOUNT,PAYMENT,COMPTIME,CREATE_BY,CREATE_DATE) VALUES (src.PK_ID,src.RD_PROJECT_CONTRACT_ID,src.SERIAL,src.PAY_NUM,src.PAY_AMOUNT,src.PAYMENT,src.COMPTIME,src.CREATE_BY,src.CREATE_DATE)
